recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7019 unless a future human review intentionally restores the old translation bullet, in which case the corrected parenthetical should remain "optional" or be rephrased without the typo.
issue_request: FHIR-7019 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for DSTU1 terminology-service section 1.23.6.10. It reported the spelling typo "optiona" on the 2015May terminology-service page and requested the corrected wording "optionally"; Jira records the resolution as "fix" and the application comment as SVN revision 5380.
initial_application: The Jira application comment matches git-svn commit afc444f28fd139774df4ca8d5fc7ef783b537c76, whose SVN revision is build@5380. That commit changed source/terminology-service.html from "(optiona) A reference to a particular map to use for the translation" to "(optional) A reference to a particular map to use for the translation" on 2015-06-03. Although the committed word is "optional" rather than Jira's proposed "optionally", it is the grammatically correct parenthetical marker for that bullet and resolves the reported typo.
additional_context: source/terminology-service.html is still an active current-build page, referenced from source/hierarchy.xml and source/documentation.html. The current translation section has since been rewritten around the ConceptMap $translate operation and no longer contains the old "particular map" bullet or the misspelling. Zulip and Confluence searches found no discussion or minutes that change the Jira/source conclusion. FHIR-7553 is a separate terminology-service typo audit already represented on the combined branch and does not require another source change for FHIR-7019.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The misspelling was corrected in the historical source application, and the current active terminology-service source contains neither the stale misspelling nor the old affected bullet.

related_jiras.note: Separate terminology-service typo audit already represented on the combined branch; it confirms the page had neighboring typo fixes but does not change the FHIR-7019 decision.
